headline: Hackers exploit Barracuda email gateway flaws for root access
summary: Barracuda Networks warned that attackers are exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway vulnerabilities to run commands with root privileges, scanning for exposed devices.

claims.statement: Attackers are exploiting two recently patched Barracuda ESG vulnerabilities to gain root access.

sources.quote: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access
Cybersecurity company Barracuda Networks warned that attackers have begun exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities that let them run commands with root privileges.
Barracuda’s email security gateways bitten by make-me-root vulns
